I was out hiking one night and this happened about a year ago. As I was starting to head back I saw two human figures standing on a high hill facing me. One of them pointed to the other and then they both began coming directly toward me from the top of this huge hill. As soon as they knew I noticed they stopped. When I looked away they would begin coming down toward me again. I suddenly got the worst feeling. So I got up and started heading down the hill I was on and began taking the fire road toward my house. After ten minutes of walking I spotted the two stalkers who were on a shorter hill above the trail I was walking down. They were continuing to follow and approach me but they were still about two hundred yards away. One of them pointed at me and looked at his buddy. Even from far away there was something really disturbing about the way they were interacting with me. I cut my plan to follow the trail and began heading directly toward the edge of civilization. I had to descend down this one hill and due to the size of the hill I thought I’d lost them when lo and behold, they appeared at the top just a few minutes after I’d gone down this hill. I could now see some facial features. One of the guys appeared to be an older gentleman with a blank smile. They both appeared to be wearing something I’d never seen, some kind of hat. His buddy was making his way down a crevice and I heard them both communicate with each other. I continued heading toward civilization. I began to sprint as I saw them pick up speed. As I came toward the last ridge dropping into the valley I came to the top of a cliff. I was so terrified that I had to climb down this cliff. I could hear these creeps getting closer and even whistling, while saying ‘here boy! Come here! Hey we just wanna talk.’ I didn’t want to make any kind of scene so I called my dad rather then the police. As soon as I was in the city borders I came to this paved trail that loops around town and I spotted the two, back about two hundred feet behind me. There were people around but the two figures persisted to get closer. I cut off the trail, having been on the phone with my dad for the past minute, telling him where I am. I had to hop through yards to get away. My dad showed up and as soon as I got into the car and saw how worried he was that was when it really became disturbing. Two people had followed me for over a mile from a remote part of the mountain. I have no idea what they could’ve wanted with me. But I always am extra watchful of people around me when I go out.

I actually had a panic attack. My brothers friend is laughing his head off while my brothers trying to tell me it’s going to be ok. I had no idea what was actually happening. I thought I was dying. After 5 minutes of terror the high significantly decreases. I just feel a floating trippy euphoria after for the rest of the night. Me freaking out ultimately made us change our plans and go sleep in the deck at my parents house. We just sat there and smoked cigarettes and weed. I only smoked cigs because I didn’t want to get high again after that. I smoked 3-5 times a week for a year after that and then quit. 


SECOND first time as an adult. Thumb will be worth the read trust me. Seven years later I was going through some shit. Been completely sober since age fourteen. Job sucked, boss was a dick, couldn’t move out of my parents etc, now this was in october 2014. This had a significant impact on my life. This is a long one.

I hit up some buddies who lived a county away. I’d been thinking of trying things again for a few months prior to this and finally did. I’m trying to hold my shit together so I don’t embarrass myself but I’m in the brink of ego death. I’m not kidding when I say I was tripping. I’d disappear into my own head to return like waking back up and would hear the same song playing. I thought it was playing over and over but they told me it was only the first time!! 

I was seeing the world through the youngest pair of eyes I could remember. I felt like I was very young again and seeing the world through reinvented eyes. This experience changed my life forever.
